messages:
remy: flagging an invoice-preview divergence: billed tokens for route=preview-lite jumped ~22% for a handful of tenants after the routing policy tweak at 06:00 UTC. Console preview shows list_price applied but later aggregation corrects to discounted price.

tara: pulling raw ingest samples now. query I ran: `SELECT tenant_id, retry_count, sum(tokens) FROM ingest.raw WHERE route='preview-lite' AND ts >= '2026-03-12T06:00:00Z' GROUP BY tenant_id, retry_count LIMIT 50;` retry_count>0 rows dominate the delta.

vince: grabbed a quick sample from Kafka: `kcat -C -b kafka:9092 -t ingress-raw -p 3 -o -200 | jq -c 'select(.route=="preview-lite")' | sed -n '1,80p'` — many retry events have headers object missing `route_meta_id` and `promo_id`.

ops-bot: deploy-tracker: edge-proxy v3.2.0 canary started 05:56 UTC, progressed 06:08 UTC. No automated rollbacks.

remy: hypothesis: new retry handling path in edge-proxy v3.2.0 doesn't preserve route_meta headers on retries, which causes downstream aggregation to treat events as full-price. That explains preview mismatch.

tara: remediation options: A) rollback v3.2.0 canary, B) add a cheap enrichment in the ingest consumer to reconstruct route_meta_id when missing using tenant->promo lookup and retry_count>0, C) do no-op and accept later invoice corrections.

vince: enrichment sounds safest operationally. Implementation notes: idempotent enrichment only when `route='preview-lite' AND route_meta_id IS NULL AND retry_count>0`; add header `X-RouteMeta-Backfilled=true`; emit metric `ingest.enrich.preview_lite.backfilled`. Also write a tombstone event to a compacted topic to avoid double-backfills on replays.

billing-bot: Finance asks for an affected_token_sum and a rough USD impact estimate before any retroactive ledger changes.

remy: agreed. sample query to compute impact: `SELECT sum(tokens) as affected_tokens, approx_usd(affected_tokens) FROM ingest.agg WHERE route='preview-lite' AND route_meta_id IS NULL AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-12T06:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-13T06:00:00Z'` — please run and attach numbers.

tara: running now. preliminary: affected_tokens ~ 1.2M tokens across 14 tenants; rough USD delta ~ $120 (assuming $0.0001/token). I'll paste exact when job finishes.

vince: tests: add a small e2e in routing-tests that issues a request with retry semantics against the proxy and asserts the route_meta_id header is present on the retried message. I'll draft the test.

remy: console UX request: add a small "derived" badge + tooltip on invoice preview rows when price derived from enrichment/backfill rather than explicit header. Also include a quick link to raw event for audit. This reduces surprises for customers and CS.

ops-bot: incident ticket created: INC-4998. Ops will stand by for rollback if enrichment causes consumer lag > 2s. Canary plan: deploy enrichment to one ingest consumer instance for 10m, monitor `ingest.consumer.lag` and `ingest.enrich.preview_lite.backfilled`.

billing-bot: Finance: if you proceed with a replay/backfill please tag adjustments with memo `backfill:route-meta-reconstruction-2026-03-12` so CS can triage communications.

remy: action items: tara to post exact affected_tokens and USD estimate in thread; vince to open routing-tests PR; tara to open enrichment PR with tombstone and metrics; ops to prepare rollback playbook. We'll canary enrichment for 30m then run a limited replay of 1h window.

tara: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infer/ingest/pull/478  includes enrichment, tombstone write, metrics, and a small perf note (0.025ms/event at current QPS). Starting canary in 15m.

vince: PR for routing-tests opened too.

remy: thanks team. keep updates here and ping if Finance needs more granularity. :thumbsup:
